instruction: Consume V2 as a negative transfer counterexample. V2 synthesized exact oracles but repair degraded mean hidden score from 0.5278 to 0.5 because the shadow defect generator admitted one-way structural wrappers such as abs(), while the current active mutation grammar has no inverse unwrap operation. V3 must not lower the 6-fragment / 4-source-file / exact-hidden gates. Discover additional real candidates from nested algebraic AST subexpressions. Admit only defects produced by non-structural active mutations for which the same active grammar can mechanically reach the original parent again. During repair, do not preselect a fixed batch of tests against only the initial defect. Repeatedly compare the current candidate to YADO's synthesized oracle, let the active evidence selector choose a new counterexample, add it to memory, and rerun active repair from the original mutated shadow source with accumulated self-tests. Stop only when no bounded disagreement remains or the iteration budget is exhausted. Original source remains hidden from the patch path.
